services.description: Development of lightweight, elegant, and responsive interfaces using the best tools on the market!
Scalable and optimized REST APIs, with Swagger documentation and data validation!
Experience with the most widely used tools on the market; Docker, Git, Swagger, Github, Bitbucket, Heroku, Vercel, and much more!

cards.title: Bakery Ecommerce
cards.description: E-commerce integrated with the Stripe payments API. The website aims to present products and prices to customers with clarity and visual appeal.

cards.title: Travel Landing Page
cards.description: Website for a travel agency, featuring a responsive design and built to provide the best possible user experience.

cards.title: Travel App | Draftbit
cards.description: Travel agency app built using the Draftbit tool based on a template. The app uses React Native in its code.

cards.title: Real Estate App | Draftbit
cards.description: Real estate search app built using the Draftbit tool based on a template. The app uses React Native in its code.

cards.title: Google Sheets Integrated API
cards.description: API integrated with Google Sheets that performs all necessary CRUD operations to integrate with an application of your choice!

cards.title: Petshop REST API
cards.description: REST API built with NestJS (a framework that simplifies the creation of Express APIs in a fast and organized way) with JWT authentication using MongoDB as the database.

cards.title: Product Sales Bot | Mercado Pago API + Telegram
cards.description: Sales bot integrated with the Mercado Pago API that allows product sales through Telegram. The bot generates payment links and sends the product to the customer after payment, automatically identifying the payment and completing the sale.

cards.title: AI Image Generator | Freepik API
cards.description: AI image generator chatbot using the Freepik or NovitaAI API. The chatbot includes a monthly subscription with payments handled via the Mercado Pago API.

cards.title: AI Excel Chatbot | Freepik API
cards.description: A chatbot designed to teach users useful Excel tricks and how to use its more advanced features.
